d.tr: Do you do it for money?
d.j: The user is directly asking if the expert performs services for payment.

d.seg: पैसे लेके करते हो तीन सौ
d.tr: Do you do it for money, three hundred
d.j: The user is directly inquiring about the rate for the service.

d.seg: पचतना लेती हो तीन सौ पचास
d.j: The user is explicitly stating a price for the service.

d.seg: तीन सौ पचास आपको देंगे तोुम तीन सौ
d.tr: If you give you three hundred fifty, then three hundred
d.j: The user is negotiating payment for the service.

d.seg: एक सौ पचास देंगे दो सौ रुपे मिला चौद आएगे बढ़िया से अच्छे से
d.tr: We will give one hundred fifty, two hundred rupees will come, nicely and well
d.j: The user is offering a specific amount of money in exchange for the service.
